headline: Chris Evans' Video Reunites Inseparable Dog Pair With Forever Home
meta_description: Actor Chris Evans featured two bonded shelter dogs on 'Dream Date' series, and within days they found a loving home together.
summary_short: Chris Evans highlighted Greg and Carley, a chihuahua-retriever pair who couldn't be separated, on The Dodo's 'Dream Date' series—and they were adopted together.
body:
When Chris Evans sat down to play games and share stories with Greg and Carley at the Animal Rescue League of Boston, he knew their adoption would depend on finding a home willing to take both dogs. The short-haired chihuahua and shaggy golden retriever were inseparable, and the shelter refused to split them up. Evans featured the bonded pair on The Dodo's "Dream Date" series, a show that invites Hollywood stars to spend time with dogs needing homes. In the video, Evans spoke directly to potential adopters: "They're a bonded pair, which means they have to be adopted together. They're a couple of sweethearts, and I hope someone out there gives them their forever home." The appeal worked. Shortly after the episode aired, Greg and Carley were adopted by a couple who immediately created an Instagram account to document their new life together at @lifewithgregandcallie.

The "Dream Date" series, which has now featured over 200 entries, has become a powerful tool for animal rescue. Evans isn't the only major Hollywood name lending his platform to the cause—the series has included his Avengers co-star Scarlett Johansson, Simon Cowell, and Matt Damon, among many others. Evans brought a personal touch to his appearance, sharing stories about his own dogs living under his roof, including his boxer-mix Dodger, and explaining the parallels between animal companionship and human family bonds.

The success of Greg and Carley's story underscores why the series maintains such a strong adoption track record. When a beloved actor takes time to genuinely engage with shelter animals, it opens hearts and homes.
